messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: High error rate and elevated latencies observed for serving cluster in west-eu1 zone-b. Detection: 46% 5xx rate on /v1/generate, median p95 latency 3.2s. Pager sent to oncall.
Marta (oncall): acked. diving in now. @Liam can you pull peering/egress metrics? any network provider notices?
Liam (sre): seeing BGP flap spikes on our peering to PEER-EOX affecting west-eu1 egress. Upstream flaps started ~1802345600. Packets dropped -> retries -> tokenization timeouts. west-eu2 peering fine. logs snippet:
```
# last 5 min
peer: PEER-EOX west-eu1: flaps=18, state=NOT_READY
iface eth3 rx_errs=0 dropped=1200
service: inference-gpu-0 p95=3200ms errors=46%
```
Liam (sre): initial mitigation options: (1) temporarily divert new sessions from west-eu1 to west-eu2 via smart-routing policy; (2) enable model-fallback to quantized-8bit variants for west-eu1 to reduce CPU/GPU pressure; (3) coordinate with peering provider for emergency patch. Recommend 1+2 immediately.
Marta (oncall): agreed. I'll flip routing policy to prefer west-eu2 for new requests, keep sticky sessions for existing ones. Will post status page update. Jess, you'll take handoff in ~20m — I'll add runbook notes here.
OpsLead: pls confirm capacity headroom in west-eu2. we should avoid cascading overload.
Liam (sre): west-eu2 has ~25% headroom for current traffic patterns; if we divert fully we risk queueing for 30-45m. Propose partial diversion (65% new traffic) and enable request throttling on heavy routes (/v1/stream large-models).
Marta (oncall): executing changes now: routing policy -> `route.pref = ["west-eu2:0.65","west-eu1:0.35"]`, enabled model-fallback config for west-eu1: `fallback_variant: q8_compat`.
Marta (oncall): executing status page draft, posting now.
Product-Ops: can you paste the status page copy so CS/sales can re-use?
Marta (oncall): status.redwood.com update (draft):
```
Summary: Partial serving degradation in west-eu1 (zone-b). Some customers may observe increased latency and higher error rates for requests routed to west-eu1.
Impact: ~20% of requests routed to west-eu1 have elevated latency and transient 5xx errors. Automatic routing adjustments in progress to reduce impact; many requests are being diverted to west-eu2 where performance is nominal.
Mitigation: Traffic diversion and model-fallbacks enabled. Engineering is coordinating with our peering partner to resolve upstream flaps. No persistent data loss.
ETA: investigation ongoing; next update in 15 minutes or on resolution.
```
Rebecca (customer-success): copying for customer notifications. I'll prep a short customer-facing blurb.
Rebecca (customer-success): customer email template (short):
```
Hi <Customer>,
We're investigating a partial degradation affecting requests routed through our west-eu1 zone. You may see higher latencies or transient errors. Our system is diverting traffic to alternate regions and applying temporary fallbacks to reduce impact. No data loss expected. We're working with our network partner and will update within 15 minutes.
If you see persistent issues, please reply to this message or open a support ticket.
— Redwood Inference Status
```
Marta (oncall): added internal slack note for sales: `Heads-up: west-eu1 partial degradation -> diverting to west-eu2, some customers may see latency. Use CS template above. Escalate critical customers to OpsLead.`
OpsLead: good. also tag any high-commitment customers: @rebecca please prioritize customers with Dedicated contracts in eu region.
Rebecca (customer-success): ack. I'll send targeted pings to top 5 affected customers and paste logs if requested.
Liam (sre): started a concurrent action: enabled additional egress paths to PEER-ALT via `egress-policy add route=PEER-ALT priority=10`. This will create alternative BGP path; propagation may take ~2-4m.
Marta (oncall): observed drop in 5xx rate to 18% after partial diversion and q8 fallbacks. p95 latency down to 1.1s for diverted traffic. continuing to monitor.
Product-Ops: can we capture a short internal template for incident comms? paste below so we can reuse.
Marta (oncall): internal incident comms template (use for Slack/email):
```
Short summary: Partial degradation in <region> affecting inference endpoints.
Scope: affected region(s), estimated impact (errors/latency), % traffic impacted.
Mitigation steps taken: routing diversion, model fallback, egress path change, partner escalated.
Customer action: none required, optional workaround = use region override to <other-region>.
Primary contacts: oncall, SRE lead, CS lead.
Next update: <time>
```
Jess (next-oncall): I'll take the night handoff. Marta, paste runbook pointers and any outstanding items.
Marta (oncall): runbook notes for handoff -> outstanding items:
- Monitor peering provider incident ticket #PEER-2026-91 for resolution.
- Watch error rate on `/v1/generate` west-eu1 and diversion ratio metrics: `route.pref` and `inflight_queues`.
- If 5xx > 30% or west-eu2 headroom <10% -> escalate to OpsLead and consider global throttling for heavy endpoints.
- Revert model-fallback after peering stabilized; record perf regression tests.
Marta (oncall): handoff checklist: updated status page, customer emails queued by Rebecca, partial diversion in place, q8 fallback enabled, alt egress added.
Jess (next-oncall): ack. I'll monitor for 4 hours. if provider doesn't stabilize, we'll prepare a broader status page update and CS script.
OpsLead: set a follow-up meeting at +2h if still degraded. good work team.
IncidentBot: NOTE: next update reminder scheduled for 1802346300.
Marta (oncall): final for now: impact reduced but not fully resolved. continuing monitoring. handing to Jess in 12m. :loudspeaker:
Rebecca (customer-success): pinged top-5 customers and posted the CS-thread. will escalate any P1s immediately.
Jess (next-oncall): received handoff. I'll post a new update if anything changes, otherwise will close when peering partner confirms stability and 5xx back to baseline.
